label_method: Initial manual source-only transcription followed by independent assistant source-only QA of original physical page 81 (printed page 80). Reviewer inspected the complete original page before opening draft key, saved an independent transcription, then verified all 24 digits/header roles, eight literal circuit positions, and two explicitly rated spare rows. Zero numeric, inventory-feature, identity or position-class corrections. No prediction/provider/model, backend parser, or evaluator output seen or used. scope.requirements: 24 printed numeric breaker schedule facts for eight branch circuit rows: frame AF, explicitly typed trip-current AT, per-breaker KAIC. No continuous-current-to-trip conversion; connected-load amperes are unscored.
